animations.name: Medium Kick Low
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose. Perform ONE SINGLE crisp Cammy-style SF6 crouching medium kick across the clip (one kick only, never twice), pure body motion in empty air: NEVER rise or stand up—keep hips and head strictly low at crouch height throughout the entire wind-up, kick, and recovery. Elisa leans back onto her bent support leg with her rear hand dipping low toward the floor for balance, then drives ONE long, fast straight low kick far forward along the ground baseline (kicking leg fully extended straight right just above the floor, front fist guarding her chest); brief apex hold at full reach, then smooth retraction back into the starting kneeling crouch guard pose. Preserve exact face, hairstyle, denim jacket, dark pants, footwear, scale and pixel art. Keep entire body inside 512x512 with margin. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
